name: Sync Resilience — Peer Restart Auto-Resync (NAT cone, passive trigger_sync false)
description:
Sync-resilience regression test: a peer is restarted mid-session; after the restart, a NEW key is written on the other peer, and the restarted peer must auto-converge WITHOUT an explicit sync trigger (trigger_sync: false).
This is a stricter variant of `sync-resilience-peer-restart.yml` that validates the post-restart auto-resync machinery. The parent test uses `trigger_sync: true` to manually poke convergence; this test exercises the passive discovery + automatic sync path, catching regressions where:
- The restarted peer fails to rejoin the gossipsub mesh for this context - The peer loses interest in the context's topics after restart - Peer-discovery (via rendezvous, DHT peer cache, etc.) breaks post-restart - The background sync-state reconciliation thread hangs or crashes
Topology --------
Uses `topology: { type: nat, nat_mode: cone }` (same as parent test). Both peers sit on an internal LAN bridge behind a NAT-gateway container; the only path to the public-bridge boot-node is via the gateway's MASQUERADE. After the restart, node-2 has to discover node-1 via the overlaid peer-discovery machinery — rendezvous registration, datastore peer-cache lookups, or gossipsub heartbeat peer-exchange — and then initiate sync automatically (no manual wait_for_sync trigger).
Why this matters ----------------
The parent `sync-resilience-peer-restart.yml` manually triggers sync with `trigger_sync: true`, which pokes the sync state machine and forces a compare-and-push exchange. This test gates the passive path: the restarted peer's libp2p stack must re-register itself and rejoin the mesh, then the app layer's background sync engine must detect a peer mismatch and converge WITHOUT external instrumentation. This catches integration regressions in:
- `crates/network/src/discovery/state.rs` (rendezvous peer-discovery post-restart) - `crates/network/src/handlers/stream/swarm/relay.rs` (relay reservation) - Gossipsub mesh rejoin logic - Background sync state-machine (peer-detection and state reconciliation)
